{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (complete-case analysis)
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
df_mean = df_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length descending
df_mean_sorted = df_mean.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

df_mean_sorted"}
